import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageFilter
im=Image.open('radiograph.jpg').convert('L')
a=np.array(im).astype(float)

bg=np.array(im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(40))).astype(float)
hp=a-bg
hp=np.clip(hp*3+128,0,255).astype('uint8')
Image.fromarray(hp).save('hp.png')
print('ok')
